leads.description: Prototype precomputed multiscale caches for repeat viewing and NGFF label output for exchangeable masks. These can reuse a documented multidimensional storage convention, but should be adopted only after verifying the exact version-2 Zarr output, axes/units, and independent-reader round trip.
leads.decision_gate: Interoperability and workflow benefit outweigh duplicate storage/preprocessing cost for real group fixtures.

leads.topic: Bio-Formats as a selective second reader
leads.description: For a high-value instrument format outside the tested tifffile boundary, assess Bio-Formats v8.4.0 and its per-format pixel/metadata/export capabilities. Add only named formats with fixtures and an owned compatibility test; do not equate the format table with universal support.
leads.decision_gate: One or more instruments need it and exact sample, metadata, codec and failure behavior pass the team's corpus.

leads.topic: Alternative image access path without canonical conversion
leads.description: Keep original TIFFs as read-only canonical data and use tifffile-backed access; write chunked NGFF only for masks, optional caches or explicit exports. This reduces mandatory conversion and duplicate source storage while leaving large-file access granularity to be measured.
leads.decision_gate: Compare source-backed navigation and memory on target fixtures with selective NGFF derivatives.

leads.description: If napari's pinned API, packaging or layer semantics do not support the required project contract, evaluate a small Qt/VisPy canvas while keeping the image identity, coordinate, annotation and provenance model. This increases the amount of slice navigation and interaction behavior the team owns.
leads.decision_gate: Prototype packaging, pinned-version interaction tests, and project integration before choosing custom viewer ownership.

leads.description: Neither the TIFF release notes nor Zarr slicing documentation qualify full-stack memory, latency or cancellation. Decoder segment size, compression, storage and chunk geometry may dominate requested tile size. Do not claim the target until it passes representative target-machine tests.
leads.decision_gate: Measure peak RSS, access granularity, cache ceiling, navigation/edit latency and cancellation on the actual supported corpus and 8-core/16 GB host; otherwise narrow the support boundary or select an alternate reader strategy.

leads.description: SQLite transaction guarantees assume platform/storage behavior; WAL is not intended for network filesystems. The exact shared storage and failure semantics used by the six researchers are not yet qualified.
leads.decision_gate: Test local recovery plus closed-snapshot copy, relink and interrupted publication on the actual supported shared storage; choose a snapshot/backup protocol and document its verified boundary.

leads.description: The project contract proposes a general index-to-world affine, while NGFF 0.4 documents scale/translation transformations. Rotated/sheared or otherwise nonseparable geometry may not have a faithful standard representation in the chosen overlay export.
leads.decision_gate: Test actual instrument geometry. Preserve full geometry in project and sidecar; until an interoperable representation is demonstrated, export only index-space with explicit transform sidecar or refuse unsupported physical-space export.

leads.topic: Coordinate convention and viewer regression coverage
leads.description: The pixel-center index convention is a proposed product choice and was not verified against the selected reader, napari layer coordinates or raster export. The documented napari slice-highlight issue also shows that display selection/hover behavior merits version-pinned regression coverage.
leads.decision_gate: Use independent known-fiducial and pixel-edge fixtures and the #9247 selected/hovered off-slice scenario against the exact packaged application.

leads.topic: Shared live collaboration and cloud services
leads.description: The brief needs ordinary bundle exchange. Simultaneous editing or cloud synchronization would add concurrency, conflict resolution, identity and recovery requirements; keep closed project snapshots as the first exchange workflow.
leads.decision_gate: Revisit only if file-bundle exchange fails a demonstrated group workflow need and a concurrency model can be specified and tested.

leads.description: Could be considered as separate derived operations with model/software version, input identity, parameters and explicit output provenance; neither belongs to the minimum manual annotation workflow nor should imply a validated clinical result.
leads.decision_gate: Require a separately justified research use, reproducible operation record and validation plan before introduction.

leads.topic: Instrument-specific source fixtures and exact dependency environment
leads.description: The actual microscope formats/codecs, axis conventions, storage layouts and workstation operating systems have not been supplied or tested. Pinning napari, tifffile, Zarr, codecs and SQLite runtime is a prerequisite for reproducible behavior.
leads.decision_gate: Collect representative non-destructive fixtures from researchers; select and pin the minimal environment and document exact accepted cases before first useful release.
